meta.title: cppinterview — Daily interview practice
meta.description: Practice C++ interviews with a reviewed question bank, an AI coach and structured mock interviews.

Landing.headline: Learn C++ systematically.
Landing.description: cppinterview combines a reviewed C++ question bank, deliberate review scheduling, an AI coach and mock interviews so every study session prepares you for the next interview.
Landing.sampleQuestion: When should an API use a reference, and when should it use a pointer in C++?
Landing.sampleAnswer: A reference expresses that an object is always present; a pointer fits when…
Landing.cycleTitle: Do more than read solutions. Practice explaining them.
Landing.managedDescription: Administrators review every question that enters the study schedule. Adding knowledge sources, generating drafts and approving content stay in a separate administration area.

capabilities.title: A reviewed question bank
capabilities.description: Study C++ cards whose content, answers and scoring criteria have been checked before they enter the review schedule.

capabilities.title: Review consistently and see progress
capabilities.description: Spaced review prioritizes exactly what you need to recall. An account keeps progress private and available across devices.

capabilities.title: Practice like an engineering interview
capabilities.description: Cover modern C++, code reading, debugging, system design and mock interviews for C++ engineering roles.

workflow.title: Choose a session
workflow.description: Start with cards already available in the reviewed question bank.

workflow.title: Answer independently
workflow.description: Work as you would in an interview before opening a hint or solution.

workflow.title: Get feedback
workflow.description: The AI coach highlights what is correct, what is missing and what to explore next.

workflow.title: Review at the right time
workflow.description: The schedule brings back topics that need reinforcement so your knowledge lasts.
